# Rust dependency notices

RUST-NOTICES.txt contains license texts and copyright notices collected for the Windows x86_64 default-feature dependency graph using cargo-about 0.8.2 with --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --fail. The tool resolved 378 crates and 159 text groups from the fixed Cargo.lock (SHA-256 5874490003c9e44467b2ad8a8d131a7c3bdf23f32182cf333ddc945944e68d0e). Sources are crate packages and upstream license retrieval by cargo-about; no offline generic-license fallback was requested. Keep this file in the Windows package and regenerate/review it when dependencies change. Additional embedded notices in upstream code and binary redistribution conditions still require review. Models and external runtime components are not included.
